speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Intermittent Porphyria precipitated by cocaine and ecstasy use.

The clinical picture of severe abdominal pain, agitation, and isolated indirect hyperbilirubinemia in a young drug user strongly points to porphyria rather than viral hepatitis or acute liver failure. Please confirm if you have a family history of similar abdominal crises or dark urine during menstruation to confirm this.
